The winner of the **2023 Steam VR Game of the Year Award** is **Labyrinthine** (App ID: 1302240).

Navigating to the game's store page and filtering reviews by **Negative**, **Playtime: Over 100 hours**, and sorted by **Most Recent**, here are the latest negative reviews:

---

### 1. Reviewer: 灰
* **Playtime:** 455.9 hrs on record (424.3 hrs at review time)
* **Date Posted:** August 14, 2025
* **Review Summary:**
  > "The first time, the cosmetics I obtained during Easter were gone when I logged back in for the summer event. The second time, the hot dog hat I got from the summer event went missing. This is the third incident: after I collected all the Halloween cosmetics around 1 AM on October 21st, when I logged in again on December 3rd, my character level—originally over 400—was only 284, and all my cosmetics (including those from Halloween and the summer event) were gone. Everything reverted to the state it was in right after the first Easter event.
  > I want to know what this means and why this only happens to me... My friends are well aware that I had these items—we even obtained some of them together—and yet only mine are gone while theirs remain intact. I hope there's a solution, as I spent a lot of time earning all these items."

---

### 2. Reviewer: Panda Rojo
* **Playtime:** 441.5 hrs on record (440.1 hrs at review time)
* **Date Posted:** August 5, 2025
* **Review Summary:**
  > "El juego esta muy bueno, pero la falta de contenido nuevo lo esta matando poco a poco, no tiene contenido nuevo desde que salió casi. / This game is very good, but the lack of new content is slowly killing it; it hasn't had any new content since it came out almost."

---

### 3. Reviewer: xlazyfox
* **Playtime:** 252.6 hrs on record (246.8 hrs at review time)
* **Date Posted:** July 23, 2025
* **Review Summary:**
  > "i enjoyed the story mode but everything after that was a slug. im an avid collectaton lover and love collecting all the cosmetics and achievements in games but this is ridiculous, ive played almost 250 hour of this game and still haven't got half of the cosmetics. if they implemented maybe a stamp that would allow u a 100% chance of getting a super rare cosmetic or just being able to buy stamps at the shop would be a good edition. however i also think they should make it that if u have that cosmetic there's less chance u will roll it again, i cant tell u how many [expletive] times i rolled the visor and granny glasses !!! please fix this for my sanity, thank you"

---

### 4. Reviewer: Gramdaddy69
* **Playtime:** 130.4 hrs on record
* **Date Posted:** July 18, 2025
* **Review Summary:**
  > "After releasing on steam and using the steam player base to fund their game all throughout early access the company decides to release Xbox exclusive cosmetics for the game. I hope daddy Microsoft gave you a nice check because I definitely won’t be purchasing your next game Cryo. It’s not about the cosmetics btw it’s about loyalty."

---

### 5. Reviewer: egebabasultan
* **Playtime:** 264.9 hrs on record (233.9 hrs at review time)
* **Date Posted:** May 11, 2025
* **Review Summary:**
  > "bu siktiğimin oyununda nas| 200 saaten fazla oynadım rezalet bir oyun" *(Expressing frustration at spending over 200 hours on the game and calling it terrible)*

---

### 6. Reviewer: Onion
* **Playtime:** 399.9 hrs on record (389 hrs at review time)
* **Date Posted:** January 13, 2025
* **Review Summary:**
  > "This game was fun until I encountered their moderators via discord. Lying is no okay and also favoritism. The developers have a long way still to learn how to care about their players. For now + the many bugs and lags this game has, I do NOT recommend it."

---

### 7. Reviewer: Arkanjo
* **Playtime:** 676.8 hrs on record (384.7 hrs at review time)
* **Date Posted:** October 26, 2024
* **Review Summary:**
  > "O jogo era bom, mas depois da última atualização, mesmo que você consiga um cosmético e termine a fase, o jogo dá um erro e o cosmético não aparece no seu inventário. E nos itens comemorativos fica difícil conseguir de novo..." *(Complaining about an update causing earned cosmetics to fail to save to inventory after completing levels)*
